 Order

The petitioner is the 2nd accused in Crime No.1848 of 2017 registered at the Palarivattom Police Station for offences under Sections 406, 420 and 385 read with 34 of IPC, now pending as CC No.264 of 2018 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - IX, Ernakulam.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - IX, Ernakulam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner was arrested at the stage of investigation and released on bail by the Police.
The petitioner's failure to appear in court after filing of the final report has resulted in the issuance of non-bailable warrant against him.
The petitioner is desirous of surrendering in court but is apprehensive that his bail application will not be considered on the day of surrender.
2. I heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.

3. Considering the willingness to surrender expressed by the petitioner and the limited relief sought,
the Crl.M.C. is disposed of as under; i.
The petitioner shall surrender before the trial court and move an application for bail, with advance notice 2025:KER:32543 CRL.MC NO. 3622 OF 2025 to the Public Prosecutor, within three weeks.
ii. If petitioner surrenders within the time granted, the learned Magistrate shall pass orders on the bail application on the day of surrender itself.

iii.
Execution of the warrant pending against the petitioner shall be kept in abeyance for three weeks.

Sd/-
